notes.title: Issue banner reports problems although there are no jobs
notes.expected: general UX: a summary of problems with jobs should match the jobs that exist on the screen
notes.observed: The banner reads "Cover letter missing · 12 details missing · 2 to check · 1 search suggestion", but the page shows "0 jobs", "0 matches" and every tile at 0.
notes.why: The person is told there are things to fix, but there is no job to fix them on. This makes them doubt the counts and wastes their time.
notes.label: false
notes.cause: by design (jobs-6): the Jobs bar lists the profile's open items

recorded.reason: No rule (including jobs-5) explains this: the screenshot shows 0 jobs, 0 matches and the Inbound tile also at 0, yet the banner still lists "Cover letter missing · 12 details missing · 2 to check", so it flags problems with no jobs to fix.

notes.title: Old password is visible without pressing Show
notes.expected: general UX: what the screen says about hiding secrets matches what it does; a password is shown only after the person presses Show
notes.observed: The page says "one is shown only when you press Show", yet the row reads "Old job-site password: North-Flint-59" in plain text, with a Show button still beside it.
notes.why: The page promises the password stays hidden until Show is pressed, but it is already on screen. The person cannot trust the page's privacy claim, and anyone looking at the screen can read the password.
notes.label: real

recorded.reason: The picture shows "Old job-site password: North-Flint-59" in plain text with Show still beside it, while the page says a password is shown only when you press Show; no rule makes this by design, and it leaks a secret.
